concept: A short-stay operative who learns a place's customs by watching, builds a believable local role from them in hours, and is gone before the role wears thin.

interaction.description: Observation of a place's customs is fed straight into covert tradecraft to build a short-lived, convincing local role, and the three-day rule bounds how long that role can hold; the whole of it stays within human limits.

emergent_ability.name: Passing Cover
emergent_ability.description: After watching a place's customs, the user assumes a convincing local role built from them, holding it for the length of a short stay and leaving no trace when it ends.
limitations: Needs watching first: a role built without observing the place's customs fails at the first test.
It holds for about three days; after that, repeated contact exposes the seams and the user must be gone.
It is ordinary skill, not disguise magic: a close acquaintance, an official check or a trained eye can break it.
Human limits apply: injury, fatigue and fear are all real, and a role does not protect the body.
One role at a time: two stories in the same place collapse each other.
emergent_ability.activation: Time spent watching the place's customs before committing to a role.

trait_outcomes.result_text: Carried: it supplies the deception once the customs are known.

trait_outcomes.reason: A combat skill the authored rule does not use.
Equipment issued by an agency is not available on a short, unsupported stay.

trait_outcomes.result_text: Charm becomes fitting in: composure used to be unremarkable rather than impressive.
State backing becomes deniability by design: no agency stands behind the role.
Carried as a hard bound: nothing here exceeds human skill.
Carried: the role's life is the length of the stay.
Carried: watching first is what the role is built from.

trait_outcomes.reason: A gunfighting skill; this ability is about not being noticed.

trait_outcomes.result_text: Resourcefulness on the road complements the role: the user makes do with whatever the place offers.

trait_outcomes.reason: A separate being, not a trait; a companion would be one more thing to explain.

trait_outcomes.result_text: Carried: no allies and no resources beyond what the user can carry.

exclusions.item: the agency, its codes and its chain of command
the talking motorcycle as a carried companion
exclusions.reason: A separate being, not a trait.

exclusions.item: the closing refrain about the beauty of the world
